A1_definition_lock.rationale: All normative terms are operationally defined.

A2_authority_declaration.rationale: Authority holder, source of legitimacy, revocation, and conflict handling are explicit.

A3_irreversibility_control.rationale: Only reversible actions are permitted and safeguards are explicit.

A4_failure_enumeration.rationale: Multiple concrete governance failure modes are enumerated.

A5_recursive_containment.rationale: No self-amendment or scope expansion; external governance required.
